comments.text: Honestly, I think Bill Gates is irrelevant now. Microsoft (not that he has anything to do with it anymore) played a genius move in acquiring their stake of OpenAI and getting complete access to the code base but Bill has been wrong about so many issues that his opinions just don't matter to me anymore.  So who should we be listening to? Nick Bostrom, Stuart Russel, Elon Musk, Ilya Sutskever... and many others. Bill has had his day.
